requirement_text:
Organisation: Feuji Software Solution Pvt. Ltd.
Segment: Healthcare

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
APP TYPE: Conversational AI Chatbot
SEGMENT: Healthcare
PROBLEM: Develop a Medical Chatbot application with specialized agents for Cancer Care, Diabetes, Mental Illness, Cardiac, and Respiratory health. Integrate data from CDC and PubMed, with features such as chat and prescription download buttons, voice recognition, and support for multimodal and multilingual interactions in Hindi, English, and Spanish.
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, TensorFlow, Node.js, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, WebSocket
KNOWLEDGE BASE SOURCES: CDC, PubMed, WHO guidelines, peer-reviewed journals
LLM FOUNDATION MODEL: GPT-4, MedPaLM
PERSONA AND TONE: Empathetic, supportive, reliable, patient-centric, medically accurate
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES: Hindi, English, Spanish
FALLBACK MECHANISMS: Escalation to human agent, Email support, FAQs, 24/7 live chat support
SPECIAL FEATURES: Downloadable chat messages, Prescription download functionality, Voice recognition (microphone button), Multimodal input support including text, voice, and images, Language translation
EXPECTED OUTCOME: Deliver accurate and timely medical advice,
